newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila's PHIBOR rates higher across all maturities.
newsitem.headline: Manila's PHIBOR rates higher across all maturities.

text.p: Philippine interbank offered rates (PHIBOR) rose across all maturities following the tightening of domestic liquidity, traders said.

Some banks have locked in their funds in longer-term securities, while foreign funds have been moving out of the local debt market after the benchmark 91-day Treasury bill rate slipped to 11.3 percent.
"The forward swap rates are just reflecting what's happening in the spot rates," one trader said.
PHIBOR are average rates of forward foreign exchange quotes of 20 banks operating in the country.
